about: Labeled off-script cases for /api/jev/track. `cur` is the phrase the prompter shows when the off-script speech starts (index into the parsed script, id P<cur>). `asr` is the raw recognizer text of the off-script stretch (no punctuation, fillers, homophones); the harness normalizes it the way Follower.offScriptSpeech() does before sending. `where` is the gold phrase at the END of the speech (null = none), `whereOk` extra phrases of the same sentence that are also acceptable, `expect` the ideal displayed phrase after the judgment (= cur for hold). `hard` tags the hard-case families.
